description: This file contains utility functions and macros for handling tensors, generators, and related objects in the torch::aot_inductor namespace, including conversions between handles and pointers, dispatch flag resolution, and safety checks for NaN and Inf values.

methods.name: tensor_handle_to_tensor_pointer
methods.description: Converts an AtenTensorHandle to an at::Tensor pointer.

methods.name: tensor_pointer_to_tensor_handle
methods.description: Converts an at::Tensor pointer to an AtenTensorHandle.

methods.name: resolve_tensor_dispatch_flags
methods.description: Resolves dispatch flags for a tensor handle, cloning if conjugate or negation flags are set.

methods.name: resolve_tensor_list_dispatch_flags
methods.description: Resolves dispatch flags for a list of tensor handles.

methods.name: generator_handle_to_generator_pointer
methods.description: Converts an AtenGeneratorHandle to an at::Generator pointer.

methods.name: generator_pointer_to_generator_handle
methods.description: Converts an at::Generator pointer to an AtenGeneratorHandle.

methods.name: new_tensor_handle
methods.description: Creates a new tensor handle from an rvalue at::Tensor.

methods.name: assert_inf_and_nan
methods.description: Checks a tensor for NaN or Inf values and throws if found.

methods.name: pointer_to_optional
methods.description: Converts a pointer to an optional value.

methods.name: pointer_to_optional_device
methods.description: Creates an optional c10::Device from device type and index.

methods.name: pointer_to_list
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a list or array of values.

methods.name: convert_to_c10_List
methods.description: Converts a C++ array of scalars to a c10::List.
